verdict.rationale: Runway documents real-time conversational Characters with Avatars and custom voices, plus voice generation and voice cloning. Together these imply generated characters that speak, but no evidence explicitly describes lip movement matched to audio or driving a character with the creator's own scripted dialogue. Seedance's audio reference budget is only adjacent. Missing for 10: explicit lip-sync documentation, a dialogue/script-to-talking-character workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration of lip-sync quality.
